## readAndVerifyAttestations() function

Read attestations and verify the signature.

This function reads the attestations file, canonicalizes the attestations, and verifies the signature using the public key. It throws an error if the file doesn't exist or if signature verification fails.

**Signature:**

```typescript
declare function readAndVerifyAttestations(
  options: ReadSignedAttestationsOptions,
): Promise<AttestationsFile>
```
